crossRefs.note: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

translations.web: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
translations.bsb: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
translations.kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
translations.asv: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
